item.title: A 7.5-inch E-ink Weather & Calendar Dashboard Powered by ESP32
item.description:
A dedicated weather and calendar display for the wall: a Waveshare 7.5" three-colour e-ink panel driven by an ESP32. It holds its image with no power, has no backlight, and reads the same PHP proxies as the Glance dashboard. It refreshes every two hours.

Renderer output before it is packed into a bitmap. The real panel shows Hungarian; labels here are translated and the calendar entries are placeholders.
